change.batch_pdf: A probed PDF in a batch (card family document, format pdf) gets the existing document-extraction job in mode native_only through the one job authority; its retained original gains the documentOriginal receipt its bytes prove. A later probe reuses the job and never reads the original again.
change.words: On the job's completion the batch item says, in an officer's words, how many pages were read, which had text, which have no text layer (scanned, not read, no OCR in a batch), and how many passages name floors, storeys, levels or rooms as candidates cited to their page and lines. A stopped or stale read says so; the original stays kept.
change.review: A read, unlocked PDF item has a Review pages step that opens the existing pinned page viewer (source revision and SHA-256 from the case detail). Nothing is recorded without the officer's confirmation.
change.studio_add_files: The building Add files dialog sends PDFs to a batch through the uploads route and the server reader (IntakeDropDialog); CSV and Excel keep their route.
change.provider: None. mode native_only makes the model step not_requested; private documents never leave.

real_inputs.reader: services/geo area.py extract_document (pypdf 5.5.0 as pinned), its output passed through extractSourceDocument and batchPdfSettlement in a scratch run; counts only are kept here.

tests.tests/intake-pdf-batch.test.ts: queue gives one native_only job and documentOriginal, item reading; a re-probe reuses the job; a Magnolia-shaped read settles read/undecided with its words and modelStatus not_requested; a Tower 3-shaped scanned page settles read/not_understood; a PDF over 16 MiB rests kept with no job; a failed job gives the stopped words; page words
tests.apps/studio/src/features/intake/batch-mo: a reading PDF shows no record count; only a read, unlocked PDF opens its pages
tests.changed_expectations: intake-draft.test.ts and intake-ledger.test.ts kept-file rows now use DOCX and GLB, as a PDF is read; document-later-receipt.test.ts harness answers the batch item lookup with no rows

not_measured: Not run against a live database, processor or Studio session: no runtime or Docker in this task. Region citations are page plus lines or paragraph, not a box. No storey or room value is extracted natively; passages are counted as candidates for review.
